title: Static Range Sum Queries
statement_md:
Given an array of n integers, process q queries. Each query gives a range [a,b] (1-indexed, inclusive); report the sum of the array within that range.

**Input**
Line 1: n q
Line 2: n integers (the array)
Next q lines: a b (1 <= a <= b <= n)

**Output**
q lines, one integer per query: the sum of a[a..b].

**Note**: this is the canonical prefix-sum milestone problem — the one where `pref[b] - pref[a-1]` should become automatic.
source: CSES-style (Static Range Sum Queries), self-verified by hand
